articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a larger effective context window. Benchmarks show major gains in graduate-level science and mathematics tasks, with the model demonstrating stronger agentic capabilities for multi-step tool use in software engineering workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro Tops Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro model has claimed top positions on SWE-Bench Verified and LiveCodeBench, outperforming competing frontier models in autonomous code generation and debugging tasks. The model leverages an improved mixture-of-experts architecture and chain-of-thought prompting refinements that yield more reliable multi-file code edits.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new orchestration layer for Claude that allows enterprises to build multi-agent systems with structured tool use, permission scoping, and audit trails. The framework targets production deployments where compliance and determinism are critical, offering guaranteed JSON schema adherence and built-in human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Commercial Atlas Electric Robot for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics began accepting commercial orders for its fully electric Atlas humanoid robot, targeting warehouse pick-and-pack operations. The production model features improved manipulation dexterity with new end-effectors and can operate autonomously for up to 4 hours per charge, with Hyundai already piloting units in Korean distribution centers.

articles.title: Figure AI Demonstrates Real-Time Conversational Task Execution on Figure 02 Humanoid
articles.summary: Figure AI showcased its Figure 02 humanoid robot performing complex multi-step assembly tasks directed by natural language instructions in real time, using an on-device vision-language-action model. The demonstration highlighted zero-shot generalization to novel objects, a key milestone for deploying general-purpose humanoid robots in unstructured manufacturing environments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Process Node for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has entered high-volume manufacturing on its A16 (2nm-class) process node using backside power delivery, with initial wafers allocated to AI accelerator and HPC clients. The node delivers roughly 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction versus N3E, which is expected to meaningfully increase inference throughput per watt for next-generation data center GPUs.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Below-Threshold Logical Qubit Error Rates
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained logical qubit error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold across 50 logical qubits using a new error-correction code on Quantinuum's H2 trapped-ion system. This milestone brings practical quantum advantage for certain chemistry simulations closer to reality, with the team projecting useful quantum-classical hybrid workloads within 2-3 years.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, focusing on general-purpose AI model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta. Auditors are evaluating systemic risk assessments, training data documentation, and red-teaming procedures, setting precedent for how frontier model regulation will function in practice globally.
